svg.aria-label: Software engineer and CS grad student at UC Santa Cruz. At JPMorgan Chase I automated credential rotation for 500+ databases, built monitoring and alerting tooling, and owned production releases. Now I work on making AI systems better and faster, like an evolutionary search framework that lets an LLM rewrite VLM inference code.
